text: {"rules":[{"id":"HTN-SCREEN-18PLUS","version":"April 2021","title":"Hypertension screening with office blood pressure measurement in adults 18 years or older without known hypertension","source_quote":"The USPSTF recommends screening for hypertension in adults 18 years or older with office blood pressure measurement (OBPM).","grade":"A","effective_date":"April 2021","action":"Screen for hypertension with office blood pressure measurement","denominator":"{\"all\": [{\"age\": {\"min\": 18, \"at\": \"end\"}, \"quote\": \"adults 18 years or older\"}], \"quote\": \"adults 18 years or older without known hypertension\"}","numerator":"{\"observation\": {\"concept\": \"blood_pressure\", \"window\": [\"{MY}-01-01\", \"{MY}-12-31\"], \"pick\": \"any\"}, \"quote\": \"office blood pressure measurement (OBPM)\", \"derived\": {\"window\": \"The section states no screening interval; a measurement-year (annual) window is an assumption requiring human review\"}}","exclusions":"[{\"condition\": {\"concept\": \"hypertension\", \"onset_before\": \"{MY}-01-01\"}, \"quote\": \"without known hypertension\", \"derived\": {\"onset_before\": \"'Known' hypertension interpreted as a diagnosis recorded before the measurement year; the cutoff date is not stated in the text\"}}]"}],"coverage_notes":["Screening interval is not stated in this section; the numerator window (measurement year) is an assumption declared as derived and needs human review.","The interpretation of 'known hypertension' as a diagnosis recorded before the measurement year is declared as derived.","Not represented: 'The USPSTF recommends obtaining blood pressure measurements outside of the clinical setting for diagnostic confirmation before starting treatment.' This is a diagnostic-confirmation step conditional on an elevated screening result and before treatment initiation; not encoded as a rule.","Numerator does not require that the reading be taken in an office setting specifically; setting of measurement (office vs. home/ambulatory) may not be reliably distinguishable in structured data.","The DATE field contains an asterisk ('April 2021 *') referencing a footnote not included in the section text; its content could not be represented."]}
